descriptions.d25j_release_parts_8017b348: Calls 0x801859f8, holds the shape found under the key at +4, searches its list for part +124 (if active) or part +120; on a hit notifies the shape through 0x801ef380, releases and clears both parts and returns the 0x801859f8 result; on a miss makes and destroys a copy of the node's name string and returns 0x80004005.
